positions.thesis: TRON stablecoin-settlement-rail dominance + deflationary burn mechanics (burns outpacing emissions) with rising OI (+12.7%/24h, +13.1%/7d) confirming the price uptrend on near-zero funding (0.01%/8h, no crowded-long risk); price above both 50DMA ($0.3269) and 200DMA ($0.31839) in golden-cross state with moderate (2.8%) extension; RSI 66.3 in the healthy 55-70 band.
positions.thesis_test: OI keeps expanding alongside price (not diverging); price holds above the 50DMA; funding stays near-zero to slightly positive (no crowding); confluence holds >=7/10 at the next checkpoint to justify the stage-2 add to full 10% size.
positions.invalidation_conditions: Price closes below $0.318 (just under the 200DMA, breaking the 'price>50DMA>200DMA' golden-cross structure) OR confluence reads >=4/10 Bearish for 2 consecutive checkpoints OR thesis marked Broken.
